７ Note
Pausing the Phishing Triage Agent is only available to users with the Security
Administrator role.
2. Select Pause to temporarily stop the agent. Once paused, the button updates to Resume,
which you can select when you’re ready to reactivate the agent’s activities.
Removing the agent permanently disables it. Once removed, triage and classification of new
incidents stop, and all feedback is deleted. However, the history of previously triaged incidents
is retained for your reference.
To remove the agent, navigate to the Overview page under Agents, then select Remove agent.
